budget-lr0.scope: Explicitly trained zero/one/two generated-state budgets. Telemetry extra_steps contains graph IDs, not token counts. Uniform real-token NTP; independent exact sequential readout remains required.
budget-lr0.legacy_engine_scope: Persistent one-latent-per-source screen with complete endpoint cooldown and uniform original-token NTP. Fixed Jacobi rounds are not thought-budget scaling. No teacher,learned allocation or sequential-inference equivalence claim.
budget-lr0.warm_timing_scope: Legacy engine mean excludes first three updates only; includes first use of graphs24/25. Full fit wall time retains all first-use and audit costs.

audit-budget-lr0.scope: Complete CPU state restoration and independent SDPA/CE full-global gradients. Separate Native next-update replay was qualified on disposable weights; no stronger scientific restart equivalence claimed here.
